tools.name: intruder_list_targets
tools.description: List the targets (domains, IPs, cloud accounts) in the Intruder account, with scan status, tags and last scan time. GET /v1/targets/.

tools.name: intruder_add_target
tools.description: Add one target (a domain, hostname or IP address) to the Intruder account, with optional tags. It adds the target to scope and does not start a scan. POST /v1/targets/.

tools.name: intruder_list_scans
tools.description: List current and past scans with status, type, target count and timestamps. GET /v1/scans/.

tools.name: intruder_get_scan
tools.description: Get one scan by id, including its status, targets and timestamps. GET /v1/scans/{id}/.

tools.name: intruder_list_scan_schedules
tools.description: List the recurring scan schedules on the account. This list is not paginated. GET /v1/scans/schedules/.

tools.name: intruder_start_scan
tools.description: Start a vulnerability scan on chosen targets or tags. Set all_targets to true to scan every target (the API default). Starting a scan uses plan scan capacity. POST /v1/scans/.

tools.name: intruder_cancel_scan
tools.description: Cancel a scan that is in progress. POST /v1/scans/{id}/cancel/.

tools.name: intruder_list_issues
tools.description: List the current security issues across the account, with severity, category and affected counts. Filter by severity, target or tag. GET /v1/issues/.

tools.name: intruder_list_issue_occurrences
tools.description: List where one issue was found: each occurrence is one affected target, port or path. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/.

tools.name: intruder_get_occurrence_scanner_output
tools.description: Get the raw scanner output that proves one occurrence of an issue. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/scanner_output/.

tools.name: intruder_list_occurrence_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one occurrence of an issue, newest first. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/comments/.

tools.name: intruder_add_occurrence_comment
tools.description: Add a plain-text comment to one occurrence of an issue, for example a triage note. POST /v1/issues/{issue_id}/occurrences/{occurrence_id}/comments/.

tools.name: intruder_list_issue_targets
tools.description: List the targets affected by one issue. GET /v1/issues/{issue_id}/targets/.

tools.name: intruder_list_fixed_occurrences
tools.description: List occurrences that were fixed (remediated), with the remediation date. Use it to report progress. GET /v1/occurrences/fixed/.

tools.name: intruder_list_attack_surface_services
tools.description: List the network services (open ports) found on external targets, by address, port and protocol. Limited to the ports in the plan. GET /v1/attack-surface/services/.

tools.name: intruder_list_licenses
tools.description: List the infrastructure and application licences in use, to check plan capacity. GET /v1/licenses/.

tools.name: intruder_list_tags
tools.description: List the tags on the account. Tags group targets for scans and filters. GET /v1/tags/.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: intruder_list_issues, intruder_list_issue_occurrences, intruder_get_occurrence_scanner_output, intruder_list_occurrence_comments, intruder_list_issue_targets · Public sink: intruder_add_target, intruder_start_scan, intruder_cancel_scan, intruder_add_occurrence_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: intruder_list_issues, intruder_list_issue_occurrences, intruder_get_occurrence_scanner_output, intruder_list_occurrence_comments, intruder_list_issue_targets · Public sink: intruder_add_target, intruder_start_scan, intruder_cancel_scan, intruder_add_occurrence_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
